name: GTFS import and export
description: Reads a GTFS feed (zip) into the project as an existing network for one service day, cut to the map view if asked, so the journey planner rides it with the planned lines; and writes the project's lines as a GTFS feed for other tools.

importers.label: GTFS feed
importers.description: Stops, routes and the trips of one service day (the busiest Wednesday unless a date is given), with frequencies.txt as frequency patterns and route types as modes.

exporters.label: GTFS feed
exporters.description: The project's lines as a weekday GTFS feed: exact trips, frequency lines as frequencies.txt, stations for stop groups.
